title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MANIRARORA
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MANIRARORA
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA01160/2025/CA (Kaliwabo, J. P.) 06 Gashyantare
2026]
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Igabanyagihano – Icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya
burundu ntigishobora kugabanyirizwa igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo kijya
munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ngo ibe yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto
iteganyirijwe icyo cyaha.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gicumbi rwaregewe uwitwa Manirarora ko yakoze
icyaha cyo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge bihambaye byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi, rumucira urubanza
rwemeza ko ahamwa n’icyo cyaha ashinjwa, ahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25 n’ihazabu ya
20.000.000Frw. Uyu Manirarora yajuririye bwa mbere mu Rukiko Rukuru, narwo rumuhamya icyaha,
rumuhanisha gufungwa imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw.
Uregwa yajuririye bwa kabiri muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire asaba kongera kugabanyirizwa igihano
kugera ku gifungo cy’imyaka 5, kuko kuva yafatwa yemera icyaha kuburyo budashidikanywaho, kuba
ari ubwa mbere aguye mu cyaha, kuba yararangije kugororoka bihagije, kandi ko afite ikibazo
cy’abana be bari bonyine kuko nyina yabataye.
Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko Uregwa atakongera kugabanyirizwa igihano, kuko yahanishijwe igihano
gito gishoboka giteganyijwe ku cyaha ashinjwa ko yakoze cyo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge bihambaye
byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi.
Incamake y’icyemezo: Icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya burundu ntigishobora kugabanyirizwa
igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo kijya munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15
n’ihazabu ngo ibe yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyo cyaha.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko No 059/2023 ryo ku wa 4/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/8/2018 riteganya
ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 2.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA00076/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Burindwi Jean Bosco, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire
ku wa 20/01/2025.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Manirarora Papias yakurikiranweho kuba ku wa 17/04/2022 yarakoze icyaha cyo gucuruza
ibiyobyabwenge bihambaye byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi na aregerwa Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa
Gicumbi mu rubanza RP00577/2022/TGI/GIC rwaciwe ku wa 22/09/2022.

[2] Muri urwo rubanza, Manirarora Papias yahamijwe icyaha cyo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge
bihambaye byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi ahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25 n’ihazabu ya
20.000.000Frw, ajurira mu Rukiko Rukuru, narwo rumuhamya icyaha, rumuhanisha gufungwa
imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw.
[3] Manirarora Papias yajuririye Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, ubujurire bwe bwandikwa kuri
RPAA01160/2025/CA, iburanishwa rishyirwa ku wa 4/2/2026, uregwa yitaba yunganiwe na Me
Nyirihirwe Hilaire naho Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Rudatinya N. Gaspard.
[4] Mu mwanzuro we w’ubujurire no mu iburanisha Manirarora Papias nta kindi yasabye uretse
kongera kugabanyirizwa igihano kugera ku gifungo cy’imyaka 5 kuko kuva yafatwa yemera icyaha
kuburyo budashidikanywaho, kuba ari ubwa mbere aguye mu cyaha, kuba yararangije kugororoka
bihagije kandi ko afite ikibazo cy’abana be bari bonyine kuko nyina yabataye.Ubushinjacyaha
busubiza ko igihano yahawe aricyo gito gishoboka hakurijwe ingingo ya 2 (a) y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023
ryo ku wa 4/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/8/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano
muri rusange, akaba adashobora kongera kugabanyirizwa.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[5] Ikibazo cyo kugabanyiriza uwasambanyije umwana igihano kubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha
mu gihe igihano cyatanzwe aricyo gito gishoboka, cyatanzweho umurongo mu rubanza
RPAA00076/2024/CA, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/01/2025 haburana
Ubushinjacyaha na Burindwi Jean Bosco aho rwemeje ko, iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zemejwe
n’umucamanza icyaha gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu n’ihazabu, icyo gihano gishobora
kugabanywa ariko ntikijye munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) n’ihazabu ikaba
yagabanywa ariko ntijye munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozwe1;
uyu murongo ukaba ushingiye ku ngingo ya 2 y’Itegeko nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura
Itegeko nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange.
[6] Kubera izo mpamvu, uru Rukiko rurasanga ubujurire bwa Manirarora Papias nta shingiro
bufite kuko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw yahawe n’Urukiko Rukuru
aricyo gito gishoboka ku cyaha yahamijwe, bityo kikaba kidashobora kongera kugabanywa.
II. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[7] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwa Manirarora Papias nta shingiro bufite.
[8] Rwemeje ko imikirize y’urubanza RPA01725/2022/HC/KIG rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru
kuwa 16/06/2025, idahindutse mu ngingo zarwo zose.
[9] Rwemeje ko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga 5.000.000
Manirarora Papias yahanishijwe kigumyeho.
1 Reba igika cya 17-18 cy’urubanza RPAA00076/2025/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire kuwa 20/1/2025 haburana
Ubushinjacyaha na Burindwi Jean Bosco.
